channel.title: Communications Elective :: CS Two Year Refactor
channel.description: The ability to confidently and effectively communicate technical ideas to audiences of widely varying backgrounds is a critical skill for every computer scientist. The communication elective provides a safe and encouraging environment for developing these skills. Students must choose one of the following: COMM 323 - Nonverbal Communication (3 hours) COMM 326 - Group Communication (3 hours) MANGT 220 - Principles of Management (3 hours) THTRE 171 - Fundamentals of Acting (3 hours) Note: Taking THTRE 171 also satisfies KSC 060 (core communication requirement) THTRE 265 – Fundamentals of Improvisation (3 hours)
